name: block-header
title: Block Header
description: A live block's header row in a page — icon · title · controls (View ▾, Filter) · ⋯ · ↗ Open — with an empty state that hosts the source picker ("Pick a table…").

meta.whenToUse: The top row of a block that shows records from elsewhere inside a page — a table view (DataGrid embedded's toolbar), a task list — and the block's unconfigured state with its picker.
meta.whenNotToUse: A page's own header (DocumentLayoutHeader), a section heading (DocumentLayoutSection), or a record's header.
